events.name: Night of Kings
events.description:
The main floor is about to get low and slow. Night of Kings brings drag kings from the Tri-Cities and beyond — we're talking heartbreaker energy, magnetic presence, the kind of performers who make you forget to breathe.

First-time king debuts meet seasoned performers. Phish Tako commands the decks for their Azúcar debut. Puddlezz returns to the drag scene as King Puddles. Jen — known for seductive lace and leather performances — takes the stage as a king for the first time. Beah debuts after tearing up our amateur competitions. Dominic Trix performs drag for the very first time ever. Sir Knight Haven, a longtime DJ and performer here, steps into their king moment. Edward, a well-known king in the Yakima area, brings their energy to Azúcar for the first time. And Dick debuts both here and in drag, period.

Cherry Pop hosts the night, keeping the temperature exactly where it needs to be. Sharp fits, killer moves, performances that hit different. The vibe: intimate but electric. The mood: everyone's here to witness, to cheer, to feel something.

Grab a drink, find your spot, and get ready to crown these kings.

events.name: Heels Dance Class with Frankie
events.description:
Heels on, walls down — Frankie's teaching you how to move like you own the room. This is a step-by-step class built for beginners and anyone ready to level up, no experience necessary and every body welcome to strut in.

We start with the fundamentals: posture, balance, the technique that makes heelwork look effortless even when it isn't. Then comes the stretch — crucial, don't skip it — loosening you up so your hips, spine, and confidence all move together. By the end of the hour you'll have a fully choreographed routine down, sharp enough to show off and fun enough to want to do it again.

Frankie brings the energy of a big sister who won't let you quit and won't let you fall — patient, hype, and a little bit fierce. Expect sweat, laughter, a few wobbles, and a room full of people cheering each other on instead of comparing.

Main Floor, Thursday July 30 at 6pm. Come stretch, come sweat, come strut — Azúcar's floor is yours for the taking.

events.name: Heels Dance Class with Kimora
events.description:
Drop the excuses and grab your heels — Kimora is teaching a full Foley-style choreography to Buttons by the Pussycat Dolls, step by step, sultry move by sultry move. This is an intermediate/advanced class, so expect real technique: proper stretches, body control, isolations, and the kind of grounded confidence that makes heels choreo hit different.

Kimora breaks it down piece by piece until the whole room is moving as one — sharp, sexy, and in sync. No rushing, no guessing. Just clean technique, sharp footwork, and that Pussycat Dolls attitude simmering under every eight-count.

The Main Floor turns into your studio for the night — mirrors up, music loud, energy hotter than the July air outside. Come ready to sweat, stretch, and strut. Heels on, ego up, judgment left at the door.

events.name: Rosie’s Birthday Bash
events.description:
The candles are lit, the glitter's already in the air, and Azúcar smells like rum and rosas — because tonight belongs to Rosie. Step onto the Main Floor and feel the room hum before the first beat even drops, todo el mundo aquí por una sola razón: to celebrate somebody amazing.

Rosie hosts her own birthday drag show — and she's not playing nice. Expect spicy hot numbers, filthy one-liners, and looks so sharp they could cut glass. This is the kind of show that pulls you out of your chair whether you meant to stand up or not. Somewhere between number two and number three, your hips will just start moving. That's not a suggestion, that's Rosie's whole point.

After the queens take their bows, the floor becomes Rosie's playground — sudorosa, dorada, alive. Trivia nobody can win without knowing her favorite drink order, silly mini-games with real prizes, and dancing that stretches long past midnight, cuerpo a cuerpo under string lights and bass.

Bring your best outfit, your loudest cheer, and hips that are ready to work. This is a night built on heat, celebration, and pure Rosie magic — no better way to toast a birthday than twerking shoulder to shoulder with the people who love her most.

events.name: Seven Deadly sins
events.description:
Lust. Gluttony. Greed. Wrath. Envy. Pride. Sloth. Azúcar's Main Floor becomes a den of delicious temptation as Rohla Blunt summons the seven deadliest vices to life — one filthy, fabulous number at a time. This isn't your average drag show, mi gente. This is spooky, seductive, and unapologetically extra.

Expect smoke, shadow, skin, and sequins. Each sin gets its own performer, its own energy, its own moment to make you gasp, laugh, or fan yourself. Rohla Blunt commands the night with wicked charm and zero mercy — part ringmaster, part temptress, all icon. The room pulses with dark glamour: think candlelight meets confetti, sin meets celebration.

Specials on hand to match the mood — because indulgence is the whole point tonight. Come dressed as your favorite vice, or just come ready to worship at the altar of drag. Every sin welcome. Every body ready to sin a little.

August 1st, doors at 10PM. Confession starts on the Main Floor — and there's no absolution, only encore.

events.name: Amature Drag Pageant
events.description:
Three rounds. One crown. Zero mercy — pero con mucho amor. Azúcar's Main Floor turns into the pageant runway of your dreams on August 19th, as Abele Fantasy takes the mic to host the Amature Drag Pageant, an open-category showcase for talent, glamour, and belleza in every shape it comes in.

Round one: talent — sing it, lip-sync it, dance it, act it, we don't care, just bring the fuego. Round two: ballroom / gown portion, gender-inclusive por diseño, because elegance isn't one silhouette — wear the gown, the suit, the fantasy, whatever makes you feel like royalty. Round three: beauty, defined on your own terms, drag como tú lo entiendes, tu belleza, tu regla.

The room will be electric — categoría is served, the crowd is loud, and every contestant walks in a legend already. Sponsors are stacking a prize basket loaded with goodies, fresh makeup, and — of course — the crown itself, waiting for whoever brings the most heart and heat to that stage.

Grab a seat, grab a drink, and get ready to scream for your favorites. Whether you're competing or cheering, este es tu momento — full glam, full drama, full corazón.

events.name: Les-Be-Emo
events.description:
Flannel up — Azúcar's Patio is going full distortion for Les-Be-Emo, a mini music festival built for anyone who still cries to Alice in Chains and screams to Metallica. Three bands, one heavy night: Summerache rolls in from Spokane with their moody, fuzzed-out sound, Porch Cat brings the Tri-Cities favorite energy fans already know and love, and Moonstruck rounds it out with riffs that hit somewhere between nostalgia and noise.

DJ Dea holds down the transitions and keeps the crowd loose between sets — because even grunge nights need a groove. Expect combat boots next to cocktail glasses, sunset turning to string lights, and a patio crowd that's equal parts mosh-curious and margarita-in-hand.

This one's for the ones who still know every word to '90s alt-rock anthems and the ones who just want to feel something loud. Come let your inner grunge kid out — Azúcar's got the stage, the sound, and the drinks ready.
